dependencies: approved package source and exact versions
scoped service account and filesystem ownership
database connection contract when application requires DB
postconditions: service health and listener binding match approved contract
preconditions: verified target and fresh target preflight
review existing services/ports; no automatic takeover

open_decisions.decision: target identity, provider instance, generation and verified hostkey
installer release and separate application release
package sources, trust, exact versions and compatibility
configuration/data/release paths and disk mount scope
accounts, bind addresses, approved ports and service units
swap size, persistence and approved resource policy

operator_steps: resolve and review all OPEN decisions
verify target identity and collect fresh PRE evidence
confirm recoverable snapshot and evidence storage outside target
obtain separate human GO for the exact target/release/plan and scoped privileges

recovery.normalization: Only explicitly approved volatile fields; preserve security/configuration/versions/permissions
recovery.on_interruption: Stop; preserve sanitized evidence; inspect actual effects and obtain recovery review

stop_conditions: missing critical inventory or unresolved decisions
target identity/generation drift or stale evidence
validation failure or uncertain partial effects
